verdict.rationale: Kong is API-first. Its routing, load balancing and health checking are 'all configurable via a RESTful admin API or declarative configuration' (Admin API on :8001, separate from the Kong Manager UI on :8002), and Kong publishes a directory of OpenAPI specs for its APIs. decK, kongctl and an official Konnect MCP server add further programmatic paths. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that the API and UI have full feature parity (especially for Konnect features like Catalog and Dev Portal), and independent or hands-on corroboration that nothing is UI-only.
